instruction.name: x86inctop
instruction.description: Increment the x87 top-of-stack pointer (FINCSTP), wrapping modulo 8.

throughput.name: 8 instructions per body
throughput.asm: x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 2000 --unroll2 8000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r12, 5' --asm 'x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop; x86inctop'
throughput.notes: Consecutive copies chain through the internal top-of-stack pointer, so the measured 1 cycle per instruction is both the latency and the achievable rate.

notes: Consecutive copies chain through the internal top-of-stack pointer, so the measured 1 cycle per instruction is both the latency and the achievable rate. The instruction has no register operands, so no latency entry can be attached to one; the chain is over internal x87 state.
